defect.summary: The adopted amendment conditions the UNBLOCKING OF COLLECTION on an event that can only occur AFTER collection has completed.

value: F5 construct validity resolved and recorded
every other pre-observation gate in the cohort protocol and eligibility rules satisfied
the event-60 environment freeze recorded per D11

defect.why_it_is_circular: The third condition cannot be met before collection. The event-60 environment freeze is defined in D11 and in the eligibility rules section 5 as an act performed once the 60th eligible event exists. Sixty eligible events cannot exist until PRE_EVENT and D1 observations have been collected. Collection therefore requires the freeze, and the freeze requires collection. As written the gate can never open.
defect.not_a_scientific_error: The first two conditions are correct and are preserved unchanged. Only the placement of the freeze is wrong: it is a pre-ANALYSIS gate that was written into a pre-COLLECTION list.
defect.original_language_is_not_deleted: The verbatim value above is preserved in this record. The adopted amendment's bytes are NOT edited; this is an append-only overlay in the same discipline the base lock and the 2026-08-16 amendment use.

corrected_stage_ordering.name: ENROLLMENT
may_proceed_when: an adopted cohort protocol is in force
a named human has directly observed an official issuer or SEC source establishing the calendar date and a release timing explicit enough to classify BMO/AMC/INTRADAY without inference
the registration is written from those blinded official inputs alone
corrected_stage_ordering.rationale: Enrollment consumes only official date and timing inputs. It reads no attention series, no price, no outcome, and nothing whose construct validity F5 questions. Blocking it on F5 would delay the cohort without protecting anything.

corrected_stage_ordering.name: PRE_EVENT_OBSERVATION_COLLECTION
may_proceed_when: F5 construct validity is resolved and recorded
every other pre-observation scientific gate is closed and recorded
external preregistration has been submitted and timestamped by an external registry
corrected_stage_ordering.rationale: The pre-event snapshot IS the first observation, and F5 governs what that observation measures. The gap audit's F5 deadline is BEFORE_FIRST_OBSERVATION; capturing first and settling F5 afterwards would violate that deadline by definition.

corrected_stage_ordering.name: D1_OBSERVATION_COLLECTION
may_proceed_when: a valid PRE_EVENT capture exists for that event
the D1 capture falls inside the authorized D1 window
corrected_stage_ordering.rationale: The state machine forbids D1 without a captured pre-event stage; this records that dependency explicitly rather than leaving it implicit in code.

corrected_stage_ordering.name: EVENT_60_ENVIRONMENT_FREEZE
may_proceed_when: exactly 60 eligible events have accrued under the registered ordering
the 60 event IDs have been enumerated and hashed into an immutable artifact
all S-1..S-8 gates have been re-verified for all 60
corrected_stage_ordering.occurs: AFTER accrual of the exact 60-event set and BEFORE the primary analysis
corrected_stage_ordering.rationale: This is the correction. D11's environment freeze records the language version, statistics package, package version, cluster-covariance option string, finite-sample-correction option, random seed and analysis-code commit SHA. Those are recorded at the freeze so the environment cannot drift between accrual and the single analysis run.

corrected_stage_ordering.name: PRIMARY_ANALYSIS
may_proceed_when: a named human authorizer has been assigned and recorded (gap-audit E9)

corrected_collection_unblock_conditions: F5 construct validity resolved and recorded
every other pre-observation scientific gate in the cohort protocol and eligibility rules satisfied
external preregistration submitted to an external timestamped registry
removed_from_collection_unblock_conditio: the event-60 environment freeze recorded per D11
where_the_removed_condition_now_belongs: stage 4, EVENT_60_ENVIRONMENT_FREEZE: after accrual of the exact 60-event set and before the primary analysis
what_this_amendment_does_not_do: It changes no statistical rule. D1-D16 are untouched.
It changes no eligibility gate, threshold, formula, ordering or timing window.
It does not authorize collection, enrollment, analysis or activation.
It does not edit the adopted lock or the 2026-08-16 amendment in place.

authorization.prospective_only: This amendment takes effect from its approval timestamp. It does not retroactively reclassify any event and creates no pre-approval deadline.
